description: Convert an integer between any two numeric bases from 2 to 36, with arbitrary precision so values far beyond 2^53 are exact. Accepts an optional sign and common prefixes (0x, 0b, 0o), validates every digit against the source base, and returns the value in the target base, in decimal, and as its bit length and digit count. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

case.description: Digit case for bases above 10: lower (default) or upper. Accepted: lower, upper.

from.description: Source base 2-36, or auto (default) to read a 0x/0b/0o prefix. Accepted: integer 2-36, or 'auto'.

prefix.description: Emit 0x/0b/0o where conventional. Default false. Accepted: true or false.

value.description: Integer to convert; optional sign and 0x/0b/0o prefix. Accepted: at most 1024 characters.

name: num_radix
title: Integer conversion between arbitrary numeric bases 2–36
